scope: Independent read-only review and offline workflow tests; no live Run 7 mutation.

independent_validation.network: Mocked transport; no BAND sends or provider calls.

verified_invariants: Malformed same-line ACK returns a structured tool error before posting or changing watchdog, ledger, delivery-blocked or stop state.
Corrected canonical ACK succeeds within the same admitted callback.
Invalid multipart syntax and conflicting existing binding are checked by the same pure validator used after a confirmed send.
Unknown send response and already-posted conflict still stop safely, retain evidence and prohibit automatic retry.
limitations: No fresh live rehearsal or new freeze is established.
